summary: At 08:57:00Z cfg-0139 cut ANTHROPIC_TIMEOUT_S on fivo-api from 20 to 2 (dashboard:dev). GET /insights makes one Anthropic call with max_retries=0, and a timeout is raised as UpstreamTimeout and mapped to HTTP 504. Calls that used to take 2-9 s now fail at about 2.02 s: 29 of 101 /insights requests returned 504 in 08:42-09:32Z, the first at 08:58:22Z. Restore ANTHROPIC_TIMEOUT_S to 20 (or a value above the normal 2-9 s generation time). Deploy dep-0414 at 09:00Z is a no-op refactor and is ruled out.

root_cause.component: ANTHROPIC_TIMEOUT_S env var (cfg-0139), used by the Anthropic client in app/services/anthropic_client.py
root_cause.summary: cfg-0139 lowered ANTHROPIC_TIMEOUT_S from 20 to 2 at 08:57:00Z. The client has max_retries=0 and the timeout is mapped to 504 with no fallback. Normal /insights generations take 2-9 s, so the slow ones now fail with 'UpstreamTimeout: anthropic request timed out after 2.0s'.

hypotheses.statement: The ANTHROPIC_TIMEOUT_S cut from 20 to 2 (cfg-0139, 08:57Z) makes slower Anthropic calls in GET /insights time out and return 504.

supporting.statement: Config change from 20 to 2 at 08:57:00Z; the code default is 20, so the env value overrides it.
First /insights 504 is at 08:58:22Z, after the change. Every sampled 504 is an anthropic timeout after 2.0 s, at 2021-2026 ms.
Code path: client built with the timeout and max_retries=0; the timeout becomes UpstreamTimeout and is mapped to 504; /insights calls complete().
Before the change, 13 of 29 sampled 200s took over 2 s, up to 9.4 s. After about 08:57:50Z sampled 200s are all at or under about 2.02 s.
/insights 504 is new (29 in the window, 0 in the baseline). 200 volume fell, which fits slow requests becoming 504s.

contradicting.statement: The restart that applied the new env value was not directly observed. It is inferred from the 08:57:15Z to 08:57:50Z transition, since two 200s over 2 s (2095 and 4182 ms) came just after the change.

hypotheses.statement: Deploy dep-0414 (371cb6a, 'insights: restructure prompt building, tune request') introduced a regression in /insights.

supporting.statement: The commit touches the insights route and its message says 'tune request'.

contradicting.statement: The diff is +7 -4 in app/routes/insights.py only. The prompt is identical and max_tokens stays 400.
The first 504 (08:58:22Z) is before the 09:00:00Z deploy.

hypotheses.statement: Anthropic API latency or errors rose independently from about 08:55Z.

contradicting.statement: No 504 before 08:58 at minute resolution. Every failure ends at about 2.0 s, which matches our own timeout and not a stall.
Before the change, calls of up to 9.4 s returned 200, so Anthropic was answering.

hypotheses.statement: Database or cache slowness (neon-postgres, upstash-redis) or a resource limit on the 512 MB instance causes the 504s.

contradicting.statement: 504s are spread across about 25 users, and many of those users also got 200s.
All sampled 504 lines are the Anthropic UpstreamTimeout at 2.02-2.03 s, with no database or redis error.

facts.statement: cfg-0139 at 08:57:00Z changed ANTHROPIC_TIMEOUT_S on fivo-api from 20 to 2 (by dashboard:dev, note 'fail fast instead of holding a request for 20 s').
In 08:42-09:32Z, /insights returned 29 x 504. The baseline had none, and other routes were healthy.
The first 504 is at 08:58:22Z with 'UpstreamTimeout: anthropic request timed out after 2.0s' at 2021 ms. Minute-level counts show nothing before 08:58.
The code reads the env var with a default of 20. The client uses max_retries=0 and the timeout maps to HTTP 504.
The dep-0414 diff is a refactor of app/routes/insights.py with an identical prompt.
The 504s are spread across about 25 users (counts are lower bounds).

assumptions: The new env value reached the running process through a restart that was not directly observed. It is inferred from the import-time client and the 08:57:15Z to 08:57:50Z transition.
The 200 durations after 09:18Z and before 08:42Z were not sampled, so the pattern is assumed to hold there.
Changes in fivo-worker or other dependencies were not examined because the change list was not filtered by service.

recommended_actions.action: Restore ANTHROPIC_TIMEOUT_S on fivo-api to 20 (revert cfg-0139) and make sure the process picks it up, restarting if needed.
recommended_actions.rationale: The 2 s limit cuts off normal 2-9 s generations and returns 504.

recommended_actions.action: After the revert, check that /insights 504s stop and that 200s over 2 s return.
recommended_actions.rationale: This confirms the fix, given that the restart was not observed.

recommended_actions.action: If fail-fast is wanted, pick a timeout above the observed latency (p95 of /insights generation), and add a fallback or cached insight instead of a 504. Consider retries.
recommended_actions.rationale: The client has max_retries=0 and the timeout maps straight to 504 with no fallback.

recommended_actions.action: Review env var changes made from the dashboard, and alert on /insights 504 rate and on Anthropic timeouts.
recommended_actions.rationale: The change was made without checking against real latency and was not caught for several minutes.

missing_evidence: Direct evidence of the process restart that applied the new env value.
Samples of /insights 200 durations for 08:00-08:42Z and 09:20-09:30Z. logs_fetch is capped at 15 minutes, so these were only counted.
Anthropic-side, neon-postgres, upstash-redis and fivo-worker metrics and logs were not queried.
The change list was not filtered by service, so changes outside fivo-api were not examined.

what_changed.what_changed: ANTHROPIC_TIMEOUT_S on fivo-api was reduced from 20 to 2 (cfg-0139).

before.statement: With a 20 s limit, slow Anthropic calls completed. In the 08:42–08:57Z sample 13 of 29 returned 200s were over 2 s (2.1–9.4 s), and the baseline had zero /insights 504s.

after.statement: From 08:57:50Z the sampled 200s are all at or under about 2.02 s, and 504s begin at 08:58:22Z with 2.02 s UpstreamTimeout errors. There were 29 504s in the window.

changes_considered.change: config on fivo-api: ANTHROPIC_TIMEOUT_S: 20 -> 2 by dashboard:dev ("fail fast instead of holding a request for 20 s")
changes_considered.reason: ANTHROPIC_TIMEOUT_S went from 20 to 2 at 08:57:00Z. Every 504 is an anthropic timeout at about 2.0 s, the first at 08:58:22Z. Before the change, slow calls of 2–9 s succeeded. The code maps the timeout to 504 with no retry or fallback.

changes_considered.change: deploy on fivo-api: commit 371cb6a "insights: restructure prompt building, tune request" by github-actions
changes_considered.reason: dep-0414 changes only app/routes/insights.py as a refactor with an identical prompt, max_tokens=400 and the same single LLM call. The first 504 at 08:58:22Z precedes the 09:00:00Z deploy, so it cannot be the trigger.
